title: Reconciliation scope, sources and cadence (bank, custodian, payment rail, subledger, GL)
status_rationale: Specified in Unbound requirements (cited) but not implemented; no production deployment, operating evidence or independent review exists (architecture/ECHELON-CURRENT-STATE-BRIEF.md).
target_answer: Unbound is designed to reconcile continuously, not only at month end. Every authoritative balance has an independent external counterpart: sponsor-owned bank accounts (BAI2/BTRS and ISO 20022 camt.052/053/054 feeds, prior-day mandatory) to the cash subledger; custodian positions, cash and transactions to the investment subledger per security and per custody account; payment-rail settlement and returns to grants payable; and the sum of fund-level balances to the sponsor GL control accounts by entity, fund, restriction and currency. Where the sponsor's GL is kept in an external book of record, Unbound reconciles to it and is never a second authoritative book. Exact matches auto-pass, residual items route to an exception queue, and spendable capacity is derived from internal reservations against the last verified balance, never from a feed balance alone; releases fail closed when feeds are stale beyond the approved window. Because Unbound holds no donor money (CNV-LEG-001), all cash reconciled is in sponsor-owned accounts.

challenge.customer_intent: Assurance that recorded fund balances agree with money and securities that actually exist, and that differences are found quickly.
challenge.adverse_outcome: Misstated fund balances, grants funded from money that is not there, undetected theft or posting errors.
challenge.conventional_control_effectiveness: Monthly manual bank and custodian reconciliations detect differences up to roughly 30 to 60 days late and depend on preparer diligence; sampling of reviewer sign-off is common audit evidence.
challenge.legally_required: No statute requires a DAF sponsor to reconcile at a given frequency; reconciliation supports GAAP financial statements and the sponsor's audit.
challenge.contractually_required: Commonly required by sponsor contracts and by auditors relying on a service organization's controls.
challenge.historical_convention: Month-end reconciliation with preparer and reviewer signatures.
challenge.architectural_elimination: Not eliminable: external balances are outside Unbound's control. Internal subledger-to-GL differences can be largely eliminated by deriving GL control balances from the same balanced append-only journal.
challenge.automatic_enforcement: Statements, NAV publication and new reservations for an affected scope are blocked while a material break is open (RR-UNB-ACC-018-r1).
challenge.continuous_evidence: Each match decision, feed receipt and break is an append-only event with source hash.
challenge.stronger_alternative: Continuous matching with exception-only human review and an independently attested sample of auto-passed items.
challenge.alternative_verifiable: Yes, if the match log, source hashes and sample attestations are retained and re-performable by an auditor.
challenge.customer_acceptance_likelihood: Unknown; unvalidated. The prior agent judgment is kept in supporting_arguments.
challenge.invalidating_conditions: Feeds unavailable or not machine-readable; tolerances set too loosely; auto-match rules changed without independent approval.
challenge.conventional_cost: Recurring staff time per account per month; scales with account count.
challenge.alternative_cost: Higher build cost for adapters and match engine; lower marginal cost per account once built.
challenge.alternative_risks: Over-trust in automation; systematic matching error affecting many items at once.
supporting_arguments: Detection latency drops from weeks to a day or less.
Exception-only review concentrates human attention where differences exist.

agent judgment: customer acceptance likelihood 'Likely for detection speed; uncertain for replacing reviewer sign-off until an auditor confirms reliance (CNV-GOV-001).'; institutional acceptance rating 'uncertain' (unvalidated, no cited source).
opposing_arguments: Auditors and sponsor controllers are accustomed to signed monthly reconciliations and may still require them.
No DAF-specific evidence yet shows that continuous reconciliation reduces cost (UNB-HYP-005 is a hypothesis).

Institutional acceptance is unvalidated: no buyer, auditor, regulator or insurer evidence or cited source supports an acceptance rating (DD-VAL-ADV-001, DD-VAL-ADV-002). Treat any rating as agent judgment until target-customer conversations or a sourced document support it.

title: Matching rules, tolerances and auto-clear governance
status_rationale: Specified in Unbound requirements (cited) but not implemented; no production deployment, operating evidence or independent review exists (architecture/ECHELON-CURRENT-STATE-BRIEF.md).
target_answer: Match rules and tolerances are versioned policy objects. Tolerances are absolute and relative per source, currency and asset class, calibrated from observed feeds. A new source starts in ProvisionalCalibration: exact match only, every non-exact item to human review and 100 percent review for at least one full close cycle of parallel run, after which the controller approves tolerances. Differences are classified against RoundingTolerance (auto-clear with evidence), Materiality and AgingLimit thresholds; loosening any threshold requires a second approver. There are no balancing plugs or silent write-offs. External observations carry registered business idempotency keys so duplicates cannot match twice. AI may propose a match or explanation but cannot apply a manual match, change a tolerance or approve its own proposal.

title: Break management: ownership, aging, escalation and fund impact
status_rationale: Specified in Unbound requirements (cited) but not implemented; no production deployment, operating evidence or independent review exists (architecture/ECHELON-CURRENT-STATE-BRIEF.md).
target_answer: Every unmatched item becomes a break case with owner, fund attribution, amount, age and evidence. Breaks above Materiality block close certification, NAV publication and new reservations for the affected scope only; immaterial unexplained differences escalate when the AgingLimit expires regardless of amount. A break is attributed to funds through its unmatched items; an unattributable break opens a controller decision due within a sponsor-set number of business days to either publish affected statements marked provisional (reconciliation pending) or withhold them. Breaks found after close open a post-close adjustment case that preserves the original close package. Break counts, aging and materiality are reported to the sponsor.

title: Segregation of duties and independence of reconciliation from payment initiation
status_rationale: Specified in Unbound requirements (cited) but not implemented; no production deployment, operating evidence or independent review exists (architecture/ECHELON-CURRENT-STATE-BRIEF.md).
target_answer: No principal, whether human, service account or AI agent, can control request, approval and reconciliation of the same transaction. The component that initiates a payment or instruction cannot attest to its independent settlement; reconciliation accountability sits with a role outside the payment chain. Duty conflicts are evaluated per material action and self-approval is blocked. For small sponsors where full separation is impractical, compensating detective controls apply: cross-role anomaly analytics and independent periodic review, with the residual risk accepted in writing by the sponsor. This acceptance never removes the requirement that payment release involves at least two distinct people (ANS-PAY-008 tiers).

title: Independent attestation of reconciliation and auditor reliance
status_rationale: Specified in Unbound requirements (cited) but not implemented; no production deployment, operating evidence or independent review exists (architecture/ECHELON-CURRENT-STATE-BRIEF.md).
target_answer: The controller signs off reconciliation completeness monthly from a generated certification package. A risk-stratified sample of auto-passed items is independently attested each period, with sample size set by the controller from an error-bound method. Close certification is granted only when continuous invariants pass, material breaks are resolved and the sample is attested; manual close checklists are not required. Because a sponsor's auditor may rely on Unbound, the requirements call for SOC 1 Type 2 readiness from inception, a SOC 1 Type 2 covering ledger posting, NAV, reconciliation, change and access before the first hosted sponsor's fiscal year end where go-live timing allows (otherwise the ANS-AUD-001 fallback applies), and generated reports carrying information-produced-by-entity support. Today there is no SOC 1 report, no auditor engagement and no attestation. Timing follows the assurance roadmap in ANS-AUD-001, including the fallback when a SOC 1 Type 2 cannot exist before a sponsor's fiscal year end.

title: Reconciliation evidence, reproducibility and retention
status_rationale: Specified in Unbound requirements (cited) but not implemented; no production deployment, operating evidence or independent review exists (architecture/ECHELON-CURRENT-STATE-BRIEF.md).
target_answer: For every reconciliation, Unbound retains the raw external feed exactly as received, normalized records with normalization version, source hashes, match decisions with rule version and the resulting breaks, all append-only. Any past reconciliation can be re-run as of its original known-at time and produce the same result, and projections rebuild deterministically from append-only evidence with checksum comparison. System-generated reconciliation reports carry information-produced-by-entity support (query definition, parameters, population counts, hash and run log). Folio renders reconciliation packs with immutable source references. Retention periods are set with counsel and the auditor; Unbound does not invent universal retention periods.

title: Reconciliation of uncertain outcomes, returns, reversals and migrations
status_rationale: Specified in Unbound requirements (cited) but not implemented; no production deployment, operating evidence or independent review exists (architecture/ECHELON-CURRENT-STATE-BRIEF.md).
target_answer: Each payment and collection rail has an Unknown-resolution protocol: status query by idempotency key at defined intervals, reconciliation against bank statements after the settlement window, and a defined evidence combination before declaring NotReceived; re-initiation reuses the original idempotency key. If NotReceived evidence cannot be obtained within the final aging tier, two independent treasury approvers may resolve by recorded decision with duplicate-risk acceptance. Returned or voided grant funds re-credit the originating fund via a linked compensating entry and capacity is restored only after reconciliation. A reversed contribution that already funded grants creates a donor receivable and sponsor exposure case, never a silent negative fund. Migrations from predecessor platforms reconcile staged balances before cutover.
